purpose: Extend the completed strict-raw visible-token campaign with independent native Protocol-B current-frame feature production and unchanged FIFO replay. This snapshot is not a completion or contribution claim.

next_gate: Complete all 36 native feature producers, replay each through unchanged FIFO and official TrackEval, then aggregate paired per-video/seed metrics. P11/P17 remain open until independent complementarity is demonstrated.
